tasks.instruction: Pytania wlasne do mapy mysli OJAJ 2026/27 o Wielkiej Brytanii (nie z arkusza olimpiady). Z podanych odpowiedzi wybierz poprawna. Tylko jedna jest prawidlowa.

items.stem: Which three crosses are combined in the Union Flag (the Union Jack)?
options: A) St George, St David and St Andrew
B) St David, St Patrick and St Andrew
C) St George, St Andrew and St Patrick
D) St George, St David and St Patrick

items.stem: Why does Wales not appear on the Union Flag?
options: A) Wales was already united with England when the first Union Flag was created in 1606.
B) Wales joined the United Kingdom only in the twentieth century.
C) The Welsh parliament voted to leave its symbol off the flag.
D) The Welsh dragon was thought too difficult to sew.

items.stem: When is the Royal Standard flown over a royal building?
options: A) At half-mast, when a member of the royal family dies.
B) Every day, on all government buildings.
C) Only on the monarch's official birthday.
D) When the monarch is inside the building.

items.stem: Which symbol represents Ireland on the Royal Standard?
Which two animals hold up the shield on the Royal Coat of Arms?
options: A) a lion and a dragon
B) a lion and a unicorn
C) a unicorn and an eagle
D) a stag and a horse

items.stem: Which motto appears on the scroll at the bottom of the Royal Coat of Arms?
Which plant is the national emblem of Scotland?
Which plant is traditionally associated with Northern Ireland?
Who is the patron saint of Scotland?
On which date is St David's Day, the national day of Wales?
